title: update on my project now in Godot 4.7 — here's 60 seconds of the environments, water, digging, wildlife, and other systems I've been working on.
author: Carlosaga22
selftext:
the project is a voxel action RPG on a floating island where you dig through terrain and fight with a gravity caster . Much thanks to Zylann’s Voxel Tools .       

Workflow : I direct and playtest everything. Claude (Opus 5.5) handles architecture and reviews; DeepSeek workers implement the task files it plans. Codex does concept art. 3D models and PBR textures come from Tencent’s Hunyuan 3D, then go through a cleanup/LOD pipeline I built. Animals are rigged and animated by hand in Mesh2Motion, plus a few custom tools for this project.
